title: Move the .dashboard folder name (BOARD_DIRECTORY) out of board-store
notes:
BOARD_DIRECTORY ('.dashboard') is imported from board/board-store.ts by notes-store, ink-store, ship, manager-terminals and projects-file, though the folder holds far more than the board. Cost: ship.ts:10 records that the renderer cannot import ship.ts because BOARD_DIRECTORY drags board-store.ts and node:fs in with it, and anyone tracing where notes live lands in the board store. Move it beside dashboardFolder (src/main/app/dashboard-folder.ts, or src/shared/), rename it for the folder it names, and point every importer at it.

Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/217
Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/216#discussion_r4483024207
